K2: the noise test — B - A is inside the +/-3 HNSW jitter implied by 969b00d's depth_flips=2 per slice. (B-A=0)

K4: the market test — the residual (questions where arm A fails to rank the LINKING episode in its top-10) is under 10%. The linking episode almost always ranks on its own, so the graph is a latency optimisation dressed as a capability. (residual=0.000)
